items.title: Ilya Sutskever's AI reading list into a learning RPG – using kimi k3
items.raw_excerpt: I wanted to take kimi k3 for a spin. It turned my simple one sentence prompt to this. Repo here. https://github.com/praveer13/ilya-papers-quest Well, I'm mindblown. Very humbling for me as a software engineer. Took couple hours for it to build this completely autonomously. And it was all from its mobile app. It couldn't render this though from within the app - it does have a feature to preview any website and publish it on kimi's domain - but it didn't work for this. I had to put it on github pages. It doesn't store anything btw - all progress is tracked in your browser storage.
